title: services: culture points, settle mission (send + arrival), state culture fields
criteria:
Implement culture points and founding new villages (Phase 2 / T20).

== realm/services/villages.py (APPEND helpers + one hook; existing function behaviour stays) ==
1) `projected_culture(s, player, now, cfg) -> float`: player.culture_points + economy.culture_per_day(all (type, level) building rows of all the player's villages, world.speed, cfg) * elapsed_days where elapsed_days = max(0, (now - player.cp_updated_at).total_seconds()) / 86400; NO writes. Re-implement `settle_player_culture` so it writes `player.culture_points = projected_culture(...)` and `cp_updated_at = now` (only when now > cp_updated_at; keep its signature and existing test behaviour).
2) `culture_needed_for_next_village(s, player, cfg, extra_pending: int = 0) -> float | None`: owned = number of the player's villages + extra_pending; returns cfg.culture.village_cp_thresholds[owned] or None when owned >= len(thresholds).
3) `complete_build`: call `settle_player_culture(s, player, now, cfg)` for the village owner BEFORE the building level changes (so culture accrues with the old levels).

== realm/services/military.py ==
Enable the SETTLE mission. In `_check_send` remove the unconditional SETTLE_NOT_READY problem and instead, for mission SETTLE (checks in this order after the rally point and unit validation): (a) the target tile (tx, ty) must exist in the tiles table of the world with kind 'valley' and have NO village on it, else problem (INVALID_TARGET, 'ช่องนี้ตั้งหมู่บ้านไม่ได้'); the same-tile-as-sender check keeps its existing message; (b) culture: pending = number of this player's movements with mission 'settle' and status 'moving'; need = villages.culture_needed_for_next_village(s, player, cfg, extra_pending=pending); points = villages.projected_culture(s, player, now, cfg); need is None or points < need -> problem (NOT_ENOUGH_CULTURE, 'แต้มวัฒนธรรมไม่พอ'). The troop-availability check and the rest are unchanged (the units are 'settler' x cfg.culture.settlers_needed, validated by units.validate_mission_units). send_troops: for SETTLE it additionally calls villages.settle_player_culture(s, player, now, cfg) after the checks pass; settle movements have to_village_id None and no protection effects. `preview_send` reports the same problems as errors (it never writes).
`resolve_arrival`: add the branch for mission 'settle' -> private `_resolve_settle_arrival(s, m, world, now, cfg)`: lock the home village (m.from_village_id) and settle_village + settle_player_culture(now); success only when the tile at (m.to_x, m.to_y) still has kind 'valley', still has no village, and projected culture >= villages.culture_needed_for_next_village(s, player, cfg) (extra_pending 0: this movement is no longer counted because it is being resolved; the player's villages count excludes the new one). On success: create the new Village (world_id, player_id, name f'บ้านของ{player.name} {owned + 1}' where owned = villages the player had before, x/y of the tile, layout = tile.layout, is_capital False, loyalty 100, resources wood/stone/iron/food all 0, res_updated_at = now, created_at = now) and its Building rows from realm.core.slots.initial_buildings(layout, cfg); the settlers are consumed (no troops, no return trip); report kind 'settle' to the owner titled 'ตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่สำเร็จ' with data {'village': {'id','name','x','y'}}; call villages.after_change for the new village; notify. On failure (tile no longer valid or culture no longer enough): create_return_movement(s, m.from_village_id, m.to_x, m.to_y, m.player_id, m.units, {}, now, cfg) and a 'settle' report titled 'ตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่ไม่สำเร็จ' with data {'reason': 'tile'|'culture', 'x': ..., 'y': ...}. Both paths set m.status = 'done'.

== realm/api/routes/state.py ==
`build_state` adds to the `player` dict: 'culture_points' (projected_culture rounded to 2 decimals) and 'culture_next' (culture_needed_for_next_village or null).

== Tests ==
New file tests/services/test_settle.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; world = worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=1, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0); A = the human's village at (0,0); rally_point (slot 39) level 1 for A; Troop(home=A, location=A, unit 'settler', count=3); target tile forced with direct DB writes: Tile (2, 0) updated to kind 'valley', layout '4-4-4-6', and make sure no village stands on it (move the bot village away if needed)). Hand-computed expectations: culture accrual: fresh human village has town_hall level 1 (cp_per_level 2) => 2 CP per day at speed 1: projected_culture after exactly 1 day = 2.0 (+ initial 0); complete_build of a woodcutter (cp_per_level 1) finishing at t0+240 s first settles the 240 s with the old levels (2*240/86400 = 0.005556) and afterwards the player accrues 3 CP/day (check projected_culture(t0+240s+1day) == 0.005556 + 3.0 within 1e-6; build the woodcutter with villages.build at t0 and call complete_build at its due time); culture_needed_for_next_village: 1 village -> 2000, 2 villages -> 8000, 10 villages -> None, extra_pending 1 with 1 village -> 8000. Send checks: with player.culture_points = 1999.99 and cp_updated_at = t0 -> send_troops(SETTLE ... to (2,0)) raises NOT_ENOUGH_CULTURE; with 2000.0 it succeeds: Movement mission 'settle', units {'settler': 3}, to_village_id None, arrive_at = t0 + 2/5*3600 = t0+1440 s (settler speed 5, 2 tiles); a second settle send while the first is moving raises NOT_ENOUGH_CULTURE (need 8000 for the third village); target tile not valley (kind 'lake') or occupied -> INVALID_TARGET; wrong settler count (2) -> INVALID_UNITS; preview reports the culture problem in `errors` without raising and without DB writes. Arrival success: resolve_arrival at t0+1440 s creates a village at (2,0) owned by the player: is_capital False, resources 0/0/0/0, layout '4-4-4-6', 21 Building rows (18 fields level 0 + town_hall 1 + rally_point 0 + wall 0), name 'บ้านของผู้เล่น 2', movement status 'done', no Troop rows and no return Movement for the settlers, one 'settle' report titled 'ตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่สำเร็จ'; the player's village count is 2 and villages.culture_needed_for_next_village now returns 8000. Arrival failure: tile turned into a 'lake' before arrival -> a 'return' Movement with units {'settler': 3} from_village_id A, no new village, report titled 'ตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่ไม่สำเร็จ' with reason 'tile'; culture dropped below 2000 before arrival (set culture_points to 0 and cp_updated_at to the arrival time) -> same with reason 'culture'. Engine path: send_troops then realm.engine.worker.process_next(s, world, arrive_at, cfg) creates the village. Update tests/services/test_military_send.py: the old SETTLE expectation ('ยังไม่เปิดใช้') must change to the new behaviour (a settle send without culture raises NOT_ENOUGH_CULTURE; keep every other assertion). tests/api/test_api_phase0.py: add assertions that GET /api/state player has culture_points (>= 0) and culture_next == 2000 for a fresh world (existing assertions stay).
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY these (copy letter by letter; proofread): 'ช่องนี้ตั้งหมู่บ้านไม่ได้', 'แต้มวัฒนธรรมไม่พอ', 'ตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่สำเร็จ', 'ตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่ไม่สำเร็จ', and the f-string 'บ้านของ{player.name} {n}'. The old constant SETTLE_NOT_READY_TH may be deleted. No other new Thai.
- Use real columns only in tests (Player.culture_points, Player.cp_updated_at, Tile.kind/layout, Village.*). Tile rows: realm.db.models.Tile(world_id, x, y, kind, layout, oasis_type, oasis_owner_village_id, animals); a Village has NO protection column.
- Existing lock order rule: lock villages in ascending id order; only the home village needs locking here.
- Errors: realm.services.errors has NOT_ENOUGH_CULTURE, INVALID_TARGET, INVALID_UNITS.
- Keep `resolve_arrival` dispatch style (one private helper per mission). Never commit, never call datetime.now().
